system.description:
A bulky cylinder affixed to a trigger unit, a fire suppression kit is designed to spray a fire with an extremely cold expanding foam which binds oxygen in the surrounding air, starving the fire of heat and oxygen, extinguishing it rapidly. The cylinder continually refills over time.

A Fire Suppression Kit allows a character to make a Quickness (Operate) Test to extinguish a fire; the Difficulty is determined by the size of the fire and how much fuel it has. A Fire Suppression Kit is powered, and recharges after a Bed rest.
